description: Retrieves comments for a YouTube video with sorting options and pagination. Group: YouTube-Video. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

commentId.description: The ID of a specific comment to retrieve replies for.

nextToken.description: A token for paginating to the next set of results.

sortBy.description: The sort order for comments. Allowed values: TOP_COMMENTS, NEWEST_FIRST.

videoId.description: The ID of the YouTube video.

name: get_youtube_v3_video_comments
title: Get Video Comments
